method: live probe (python -m scripts.codex_app_server_probe) against `codex app-server --listen unix://<scratch>/app.sock` in a disposable CODEX_HOME (linked default auth, low effort, trusted fixture repo, hooks logging stdin); fixture prompts only

schema.digest_method: cd schema && find . -type f -name '*.json' | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum

transport.finding: unix:// listen serves WebSocket over the Unix socket: a raw JSON line got no reply within 3 s, an HTTP upgrade answered 'HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols'. The given path is a symlink (to /tmp/codex-daemon-<uid>/<hash>).

full_conversation.observed: initialize, thread/start, turn/start; turn completed with agent text ALPHA

idle_turn_start.observed: second turn/start on the idle thread completed BRAVO

busy_turn_steer_expected_turn_id.observed: during a running command: stale expectedTurnId -> error -32600 naming the active turn; matching expectedTurnId -> {turnId: active}; steer after completion -> -32600 'no active turn to steer'; final text carried the steered word (DELTA)

active_turn_race.observed: turn/start on a busy thread returns the SAME active turn (status inProgress) instead of an error or a second turn; its input is folded into that turn (final text CHARLIE DELTA ECHO); history holds one turn; UserPromptSubmit fires for the start, the steer and the racing start

thread_read_history.observed: thread/read includeTurns returns both turns with ids matching turn/start and both fixture user texts

approvals.observed: approvalPolicy untrusted: server request item/commandExecution/requestApproval; decline -> command not run, turn completed

hook_payloads.observed: hooks in a fresh home are listed untrusted by hooks/list (records/trust_hooks.json before); the CLI flag --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust is not an app-server flag (records/cli.json); hooks/list then config/batchWrite of hooks.state.<key>.trusted_hash = currentHash trusts them live. Then SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, Stop, PreCompact, PostCompact (trigger manual) and SessionEnd payloads were logged; the client also receives hook/started and hook/completed notifications
hook_payloads.constraint: a hook added later starts untrusted and needs the same trust write (records/trust_hooks_postcompact.json: postCompact untrusted, then trusted)

compaction.observed: thread/compact/start -> {}; PreCompact and PostCompact hooks fired with trigger manual on the same turn; the next turn on the same thread completed (JULIET)
compaction.unsupported: no thread/compacted notification arrived within 180 s; the schema marks that notification deprecated in favour of the contextCompaction item, which did arrive as item/started and item/completed

default_login.observed: account/read -> type chatgpt, plan present, no error; a turn completed. No values printed

token_account.observed: agentihooks balance lists only the default Codex account; no AH_CX_TOKEN_<slug> variable exists in the environment (name scan, no values), so a token-authenticated app-server could not be run
token_account.needs: the operator adds one Codex token account (AH_CX_TOKEN_<slug>); then rerun the account scenario on an app-server launched with only that token and record it beside records/account.json

tui_remote_attach_unix_socket.observed: codex resume --remote unix://<socket> <thread> attached to the seeded thread and showed its history; a turn sent by a separate protocol client while attached (LIMA) appeared live in the pane

viewer_disconnect_reopen.observed: a protocol viewer closed mid-turn; the turn finished for the bridge; a reopened viewer resumed the same thread (still in thread/loaded/list) and its turn was seen by the bridge. After the TUI viewer was killed, reopening it against the same socket attached and showed the full history (tui/reopen.txt), so the app-server outlived the viewer

two_client_approval_ownership.observed: the approval request reaches every client resumed on the thread with the same request id; the owner's decline is applied (file not created, turn completed) and the other client receives serverRequest/resolved. The other client's later accept is a response with no reply; that it had no effect is inferred from file_created false
two_client_approval_ownership.constraint: thread/resume before the first turn fails with -32600 'no rollout found for thread id', so a viewer can attach only after the thread has a rollout

sandbox_for_cxp4.observed: readOnly+networkAccess: repo write denied, ledger HTTP 200, Redis PONG, external HTTPS 200. readOnly and workspaceWrite without networkAccess block all network. workspaceWrite writes only to writableRoots (command cwd alone is not writable). dangerFullAccess writes and reaches the network
